scope: Clip create, duplicate, delete and selection per track, with references, Undo, import, scenes and export
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform
verified_behaviors: A new MIDI clip starts as rests and is selected; the step editor follows the selection on its track
Copy duplicates content under a new ID named 'Clip 2 copy'
Include in scene and the launch button use the selected clip; the scene launches it
Deleting the playing clip while playing stops the track, drops its scene slot and selects the previous clip; Undo restores the clip in place with its ID and slot
Refusals: deleting a track's last clip, a ninth clip (add or copy), unknown clip IDs
An audio clip's import lands on the clip selected when it started, although the selection changed before it finished
Export plays each track's selected clip: the imported clip renders 0.7 * 8000/32768 at frame 0; the pulse clip renders differently
Save/Open keeps every clip and ID; selection starts at the first clip
Two clips per track round trip; nine clips or none are refused when saving
QML: + Clip, the selector (keyboard), Copy, Delete clip, Undo and launching the selected clip through its button
limits: Up to eight clips per track; one clip of a track plays at a time; no Arrangement view (#91).
